Sumobot 2025

September 2024 – April 2025

An autonomous 20 lb sumo robot for the 2025 National Robotics Challenge: find the other robot in the ring, and push it out.

Details

  • Built by Alexis Englund, Josiah Huntington, Aden Muzzey, Sierra Rodewald, Zane Wilson, Jacob Decker, Steven Duong, Ethan Miller, Michael Klingelhoefer, Luke Baron, Nathan Paye, Carter Moon
  • Purpose To compete in the 2025 NRC sumobot competition

Files and code

  • Code (GitLab)

The purpose of this competition is to create an autonomous 20lb robot that will be placed in a ring and must push another bot out of the ring. You can visit the competition website at thenrc.org, and the rule book is here.
